opportunities.name: Plan a city weekend trip and email the itinerary
opportunities.description: For a given city, date range, traveler count, activities, cuisine and recipient: look up the city on Wikipedia (population), check the weather on timeanddate, find a hotel on Booking.com, find activities on Viator, book a restaurant search on the dining site, save a summary note, and draft an email to the friend with the plan.
opportunities.site: wikipedia.org, timeanddate.com, booking.com, viator.com, restaurant booking site (.co), notes app, mail app
steps: On Wikipedia, search for {city} and open the city article; note the population
On timeanddate.com, search for {city}, open the city result and its current weather/forecast page; note the temperature
On Booking.com, clear the destination, type {city} and pick the matching suggestion
Open the date picker and select {check_in} and {check_out}
If needed, set the traveler count to {adults} in the travelers/rooms selector and click Done
Click Search, open a chosen hotel and its 'Info & prices'; note the hotel name and price
On Viator, for each activity in {activities}: select all text in the search box, type '{activity} {city}', select the search option, and open the chosen result

On the restaurant site, type '{city} {cuisine}' into the Location/Restaurant/Cuisine box, open the date selector, go to the month needed and pick {check_in}, click search ('Let's go' / 'Find a table'), and open the chosen restaurant's details
In Notes, create a new note: '{city} {dates}: pop {population}, {temp} C, hotel {hotel} {price}, {activity list}, dinner {restaurant} 18:30' and press Enter
In Mail, compose to {recipient_email}, subject '{city} weekend {dates}', body 'Hi {name}, plan: hotel {hotel} ({price}), {activities}, dinner at {restaurant} ({cuisine}) on {check_in}.'
Discard or send the draft as appropriate
